title: HostelMate
description: A meal management system where users can browse, order, and review meals while admins can manage meals, track revenue, and handle upcoming meal requests. Features include user authentication, payments, meal filtering, and a dark mode UI.
keyFeatures: Admins can add or edit meals, while students view, request, and leave reviews.
Students can manage profiles and meals in dashboard; admins oversee users and meal data.
Students purchase premium packages with Stripe for added perks like liking meals.

title: Tourna - Tournament Manager
description: This is a tournament management site, where users can create teams and tournaments. Also users can manage their created tournaments, determine the champion in the tournament.
keyFeatures: In teams page, a user can search for teams or sort the teams.
Users can create or delete teams or tournaments.
Adding team member is dynamic, user can add members easily.

title: SharePlate - Food Sharing Platform
description: A platform that connects individuals to share excess food with those in need, aiming to reduce food waste and support communities.
keyFeatures: Users can add food to share with others, and people can request the food.
They can also update or delete the shared food from the database.
In Available Foods page, a user can change the grid layout, search for food or sort by expiry date.

title: PlanetCare
description: A volunteer management and donation platform for environmental initiatives. It connects volunteers with local cleanup events, tree plantation drives, and sustainability projects.
keyFeatures: Admins create and manage events; volunteers browse, register, and discuss in comment sections.
Secure Stripe payments with donor recognition wall featuring tiered badges by donation amount.
Volunteers and admins have separate dashboards to track events, donations, and users.

title: Ocean Xplorer
description: A frontend focused project with animations of all sorts.
